summary: Temporary danger area EGD496A activated at EGTT for beyond visual line of sight unmanned aircraft operations, surface to 1,300 ft.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD496A ACTIVATED. AIP SUP 108/2026 
REFERS. BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE 
TDA. A SPECIAL USE AIRSPACE ACTIVITY INFORMATION SERVICE (SUAAIS) 
WILL BE AVBL FM ANGLIA RADAR 128.925MHZ OR 125.275MHZ OR LONDON INFO 
125.475MHZ. FOR INFO AND BOOKING CTC OPS(AT)FLYLOGIX.COM OR 07784
